# GoodCash Partner API: full reference for AI coding tools
(Generated from docs/partners by scripts/build-llms.mjs. The API reference is openapi.yaml.)

<!-- llms.txt -->

# GoodCash Partner API

> Let users cash out GoodDollar (G$) on Celo to a Nigerian bank account (naira), from inside any app or game. Non-custodial: the user's wallet (or the app's own server wallet) signs ONE transaction. GoodCash never holds money or keys.

Rules an AI coding tool MUST follow:
- Use `gc_pk_...` (publishable) keys in browsers/apps. NEVER put a `gc_sk_...` (secret) key in frontend code, a mobile app, a game client, or a public repo. Secret keys belong on a server only.
- Start with a test key (`gc_pk_test_...`). Test keys never move money. Switch to live keys only when the user says so.
- Easiest integration: load `https://pay.goodcash.xyz/widget.js` and call `GoodCash.open({ publishableKey, mode: 'popup' })`. No other code is needed.
- React: `npm i @goodcash/react @goodcash/sdk`, wrap in `<GoodCashProvider publishableKey>`, render `<CashOutButton />`.
- Custom UI: `npm i @goodcash/sdk`. Always show `quote.fees` (each line) and `quote.receive.naira` before confirming, and pass that same `quote` to `cashOut()`. Never compute fees yourself.
- Amounts are G$ as decimal strings or numbers (e.g. "5000"), never wei.
- Show the account name from `verifyAccount()` to the user before they confirm.
- If an error has code `uncertain` or `pending_confirmation`, do NOT retry: tell the user to check their history first.
- Credit users from webhooks (server, verified with `verifyWebhook` from `@goodcash/sdk/server` using the RAW body), not from browser events.
- Show `error.message` to users (plain words). Log `error.detail` for developers.
- Keep "Powered by GoodCash" visible.
- Naira in (adding G$/CELO): use `GoodCash.open({ publishableKey, flow: 'topup' })` or `<TopUpButton />`. NEVER build a form that collects a customer's BVN/NIN or bank details: those are typed only on GoodCash's own page. It is switched on per partner; test mode first.

## Docs
- [Full reference for AI tools](https://pay.goodcash.xyz/docs/llms-full.txt)
- [OpenAPI](https://pay.goodcash.xyz/docs/openapi.yaml)
- [Quickstarts](https://pay.goodcash.xyz/docs)

<!-- README.md -->

# GoodCash for Partners

Let your users turn **GoodDollar (G$)** into **naira in their own Nigerian bank account**, without leaving your app or game.
One wallet confirmation; paid in minutes. GoodCash never holds your users' money or keys.

| You are | Start here | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A game (web, WebGL, Unity, mobile) | [Game quickstart](quickstarts/game.md) | 10 min |
| A React / Next.js app | [React quickstart](quickstarts/react.md) | 15 min |
| A React Native app | [React Native quickstart](quickstarts/react-native.md) | 30 min |
| A fintech / server (airtime, bills, your own UI) | [Server quickstart](quickstarts/fintech-server.md) | 1 day |
| An AI app builder | [AI builder quickstart](quickstarts/ai-builder.md) + [llms.txt](llms.txt) | 5 min |
| Adding G$ / CELO with naira (the other direction) | [Top-ups quickstart](quickstarts/topups.md) | 10 min |

Reference: [OpenAPI](openapi.yaml) · [Errors](errors.md) · [Webhooks](webhooks.md) · [Test mode](test-mode.md) ·
[Fees](FEES.md) · [Go-live checklist](go-live.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## How it works

1. Your app asks GoodCash for a **quote**: what the user gets in naira, with every fee on its own line.
2. The user picks their bank; GoodCash shows the **account holder's name** to confirm.
3. GoodCash prepares **one transaction**. The SDK checks it, then the user's wallet (or your server wallet) signs it.
4. The GoodCash router swaps the G$ and pays the payout partner exactly; any surplus goes straight back to the user.
5. The bank is paid, usually within minutes. You get a signed **webhook** (`cashout.paid`).

## Keys

| Key | Where | Can |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gc_pk_test_...` / `gc_pk_live_...` (publishable) | Browsers, apps, the widget. Only from your allowed sites or app ids. | Everything a user's own cash out needs |
| `gc_sk_test_...` / `gc_sk_live_...` (secret) | Your server only. Refused from browsers. | Plus: list all cash outs, webhook settings |

Test keys never move money (see [test mode](test-mode.md)). **Get test keys yourself, right away:** https://pay.goodcash.xyz/docs/get-test-keys/ (email-confirmed; you list the websites you will test from). Live keys are approved by GoodCash after you have tested: see the [go-live checklist](go-live.md).

## Packages

- `https://pay.goodcash.xyz/widget.js`: the whole flow, one script tag.
- [`@goodcash/react`](../../packages/react/README.md): `<CashOutButton />` and hooks.
- [`@goodcash/sdk`](../../packages/sdk/README.md): client for browsers, React Native, Node, edge; `@goodcash/sdk/server` for webhooks.
- Examples: [`examples/`](../../examples)

<!-- quickstarts/ai-builder.md -->

# AI app builder quickstart

Point your AI at [`llms.txt`](../llms.txt) (short rules) or [`llms-full.txt`](../llms-full.txt) (everything).

The smallest working integration, safe to paste into any generated page:

```html
<script src="https://pay.goodcash.xyz/widget.js"></script>
<button onclick="GoodCash.open({ publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_REPLACE_ME', mode: 'popup' })">
  Cash out G$ to my bank
</button>
```

For a React app the AI generates:

```tsx
import { GoodCashProvider, CashOutButton } from '@goodcash/react';
<GoodCashProvider publishableKey="gc_pk_test_REPLACE_ME"><CashOutButton /></GoodCashProvider>
```

Rules your AI must keep:
- Only a publishable key (`gc_pk_...`) in generated frontend code. Never a secret key.
- Start with a test key; the user switches to live.
- Don't compute fees or prices: show what the quote returns.
- The site the generated app runs on must be on the partner's allowed list. Today each site is listed exactly
  (for example `https://shop.example.com`); wildcard sub-domains (`https://*.yourbuilder.app`) are not supported yet.
  Builders that publish every app on its own sub-domain should talk to GoodCash first.

<!-- quickstarts/game.md -->

# Game quickstart (web, WebGL, Unity, mobile)

## A. Players use their own wallet (MetaMask, MiniPay, Valora...)

Web or WebGL build: add two lines to your page.

```html
<script src="https://pay.goodcash.xyz/widget.js"></script>
<script>
  function cashOut(playerId, gBalance) {
    GoodCash.open({
      publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_...',   // test first
      mode: 'popup',                      // or 'embed' (overlay on your page)
      amountG: gBalance,
      partnerRef: playerId,
      onEvent: (e) => { if (e.type === 'cashout.paid') showToast('Paid to your bank!'); },
    });
  }
</script>
```

From Unity WebGL, call it with a `.jslib` plugin:

```js
mergeInto(LibraryManager.library, {
  GoodCashOpen: function (playerIdPtr, amount) {
    GoodCash.open({ publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_...', mode: 'embed', amountG: amount, partnerRef: UTF8ToString(playerIdPtr) });
  },
});
```

## B. Unity / native mobile (no web page)

Open the hosted flow in a WebView and come back by deep link:

```
https://pay.goodcash.xyz/?key=gc_pk_test_...&mode=redirect&amountG=5000&ref=player-42&returnUrl=mygame://cashout
```

Your app receives `mygame://cashout?goodcash_cashout=<id>&status=sent`. Register your app id with GoodCash.
Note: inside a WebView the player needs a wallet the WebView can reach (an in-app browser wallet such as MiniPay).
For players without one, use option C or the widget's host signing (D).

## C. Your game pays out from its own wallet (players earned G$ inside the game)

Run it on your server with the secret key. See the [server quickstart](fintech-server.md). Keep the payout wallet's
key in a key manager with limits; GoodCash never sees it.

## D. Your game has an embedded wallet (Privy, Thirdweb, your own)

The widget asks your page to send the one transaction; it never sees keys:

```js
GoodCash.open({
  publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_...',
  mode: 'embed',
  wallet: player.address,
  signer: player.walletProvider,          // EIP-1193 provider, or async (tx) => txHash
  partnerRef: player.id,
});
```

Then credit or notify players from your **server webhook** (`cashout.paid`), not from browser events alone.

<!-- quickstarts/react.md -->

# React / Next.js quickstart

```bash
npm install @goodcash/react @goodcash/sdk
```

```tsx
'use client';
import { GoodCashProvider, CashOutButton } from '@goodcash/react';

export default function CashOut({ user, provider }) {
  return (
    <GoodCashProvider publishableKey={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOODCASH_KEY!} theme={{ accent: '#7b39fc', mode: 'auto' }}>
      <CashOutButton
        signer={provider}                 // window.ethereum, wagmi/WalletConnect/Magic EIP-1193 provider
        partnerRef={user.id}
        onEvent={(e) => {
          if (e.type === 'cashout.paid') console.log('paid', e.cashOut.id);
        }}
      />
    </GoodCashProvider>
  );
}
```

Only the **publishable** key goes in `NEXT_PUBLIC_...`. Never expose the secret key.

## Your own screens

```tsx
import { useQuote, useBanks, useVerifyAccount, useCashOut } from '@goodcash/react';

const { quote } = useQuote(amount);                         // show quote.fees and quote.receive.naira
const { banks } = useBanks();
const { accountName } = useVerifyAccount(bankCode, account); // show it before confirming
const { start, step, error } = useCashOut();

await start({ signer, amountG: amount, recipient: { bankCode, accountNumber: account, accountName: accountName! }, quote: quote!, partnerRef: user.id });
```

Show `error.message` to users. If `error.code` is `uncertain` or `pending_confirmation`, do not offer a retry: tell
the user to check their history.

Theme tokens: `background`, `surface`, `ink`, `accent`, `accentInk`, `highlight`, `success`, `radius`, `font`, `mode`.

<!-- quickstarts/react-native.md -->

# React Native quickstart

The SDK has no DOM or Node dependencies, so it runs in React Native as is.

```bash
npm install @goodcash/sdk
```

```ts
import { GoodCash } from '@goodcash/sdk';

const gc = new GoodCash({ publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_...', appId: 'com.yourcompany.app' }); // app id registered with GoodCash

const quote = await gc.quote({ amountG: 5000 });
const banks = await gc.banks();
const { accountName } = await gc.verifyAccount({ bankCode, accountNumber });

const { cashOut } = await gc.cashOut({
  signer: walletConnectProvider,   // any EIP-1193 provider (WalletConnect, Privy, Thirdweb, Magic...)
  amountG: 5000,
  recipient: { bankCode, accountNumber, accountName },
  quote,
  partnerRef: user.id,
});
await gc.watchCashOut(cashOut.id, (c) => setStatus(c.status));
```

React Native needs `crypto.getRandomValues` (for idempotency keys): add `react-native-get-random-values` and import it
first in your entry file.

## Or: the hosted flow in a WebView

```tsx
<WebView
  source={{ uri: `https://pay.goodcash.xyz/?key=${PK}&mode=redirect&amountG=5000&ref=${user.id}&returnUrl=myapp://cashout` }}
  onShouldStartLoadWithRequest={(r) => {
    if (r.url.startsWith('myapp://cashout')) { handleReturn(r.url); return false; }
    return true;
  }}
/>
```

<!-- quickstarts/fintech-server.md -->

# Server quickstart (fintechs, games paying from their own wallet)

Your server holds the **secret key** and, if you pay out from your own wallet, that wallet's key. GoodCash holds neither.

```bash
npm install @goodcash/sdk viem
```

```ts
import { GoodCash } from '@goodcash/sdk';
import { createWalletClient, http } from 'viem';
import { celo } from 'viem/chains';
import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';

const gc = new GoodCash({ secretKey: process.env.GOODCASH_SECRET_KEY! });
const payoutWallet = createWalletClient({ account: privateKeyToAccount(process.env.PAYOUT_WALLET_KEY as `0x${string}`), chain: celo, transport: http() });

export async function payUser(userId: string, amountG: string, bank: { bankCode: string; accountNumber: string }) {
  const quote = await gc.quote({ amountG });                       // show or store these fee lines for your user
  const { accountName } = await gc.verifyAccount(bank);
  const { cashOut } = await gc.cashOut({
    signer: payoutWallet,                                          // your server wallet signs the one transaction
    amountG,
    recipient: { ...bank, accountName },
    quote,
    partnerRef: userId,
    idempotencyKey: `payout-${userId}-${Date.now()}`,              // reuse it if you retry the same attempt
  });
  return cashOut.id;                                               // "paid" arrives by webhook
}
```

Without the SDK, call the API directly (see [OpenAPI](../openapi.yaml)): `GET /v1/quote`, `POST /v1/banks/verify`,
`POST /v1/cashouts` (with `Idempotency-Key`), sign `transaction` after checking it, then
`POST /v1/cashouts/{id}/transaction`.

## Webhooks

```ts
import { verifyWebhook } from '@goodcash/sdk/server';

app.post('/goodcash', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const event = await verifyWebhook(req.body.toString('utf8'), req.header('goodcash-signature'), process.env.GOODCASH_WEBHOOK_SECRET!);
    if (await alreadyHandled(event.id)) return res.sendStatus(200);
    if (event.type === 'cashout.paid') await markPaid(event.data.partnerRef, event.data.id);
    res.sendStatus(200);
  } catch {
    res.sendStatus(400);
  }
});
```

## Airtime, data and bills

To turn G$ into naira you then spend (airtime, MTN data, bills), cash out to **your own collection account** and
credit the user in your system when `cashout.paid` arrives. Your agreement with GoodCash covers who does user checks.

## Safety for server wallets

- Keep the key in a secret manager; give the wallet only what it needs each day.
- Set your own per-user and per-day limits before calling `cashOut`.
- Treat `uncertain` and `pending_confirmation` as "do not retry": check `getCashOut` first.

<!-- quickstarts/topups.md -->

# Add G$ / CELO with naira (top-ups)

Let your users **pay naira from their own bank account and receive G$ (or CELO) in their own wallet**, without leaving
your app. It is the other direction from cash out.

> **Availability.** Top-ups are switched on per partner by GoodCash. Until they are, these calls answer "not found".
> Ask GoodCash to enable test mode for you, then live later. Test mode never moves money.

## Your users' ID details never come to you

Paying naira needs the payer's name, date of birth and BVN or NIN. **They are typed on GoodCash's own page
(`pay.goodcash.xyz`) and go straight to the payout partner.** Your app, your page and your servers never see them, and
no `/v1` call accepts them. You only get the order's progress: quotes, status and webhooks.

## The quickest way: one button

```html
<script src="https://pay.goodcash.xyz/widget.js"></script>
<script>
  function addMoney(playerId) {
    GoodCash.open({
      publishableKey: 'gc_pk_test_...',   // test first
      flow: 'topup',
      mode: 'popup',                      // or 'embed' (a panel over your page)
      amountNaira: 5000,                  // optional starting amount
      asset: 'g',                         // 'g' (G$) or 'celo'
      partnerRef: playerId,
      onEvent: (e) => { if (e.type === 'topup.delivered') showToast('G$ added!'); },
    });
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { GoodCashProvider, TopUpButton } from '@goodcash/react';

<GoodCashProvider publishableKey="gc_pk_test_...">
  <TopUpButton amountNaira={5000} partnerRef={user.id} onEvent={(e) => console.log(e.type)} />
</GoodCashProvider>
```

The customer connects their own wallet, pays by bank transfer, and approves **once** in their wallet. Games with their
own embedded wallets are not supported for top-ups yet: the customer's own wallet signs.

## Events

Browser events (`e.topUp` has the top-up): `topup.created`, `topup.paid_in` (the naira arrived), `topup.delivered`
(the G$/CELO is in the wallet), `topup.failed` (expired or refunded).

## From your server

Quote and status, with your keys. Listing needs the secret key.

```bash
curl "https://api.goodcash.xyz/v1/topup/quote?amountNaira=5000&asset=g" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOODCASH_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" -H "Origin: https://your-site.example"
curl https://api.goodcash.xyz/v1/topups/tu_... -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOODCASH_SECRET_KEY"
curl https://api.goodcash.xyz/v1/topups        -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOODCASH_SECRET_KEY"
```

With the SDK: `gc.topUpQuote({ amountNaira })`, `gc.getTopUp(id)`, `gc.watchTopUp(id, onChange)`, `gc.listTopUps()`.

Statuses: `awaiting_payment` → `paid_in` → `delivered`; or `failed` / `expired`.

**Webhooks** (same signed, retried delivery as cash out): `topup.paid_in`, `topup.delivered`, `topup.failed`. `data` is the
top-up. Credit your user from `topup.delivered`, not from browser events alone.

## Quote

`youGet.amount` is about what the customer receives and `youGet.minimum` is the least. Show every line in `fees`. A quote
is good for about 30 seconds. The smallest top-up is ₦1,000 (`minimumNaira`).

## Test mode

Simulated end to end, in a few seconds: waiting, then the naira lands (about 5 s), then delivered (about 15 s). **An amount
ending in 13 fails**, so you can test your failure path. No wallet or ID details are asked for in test mode.

## Fees

GoodCash's top-up price is shown as lines in the quote (a payment partner fee and a network and exchange fee). There is
no partner fee on top-ups yet.

<!-- FEES.md -->

# Fees for partners

What the customer sees, each on its own line:

| Line | Who | How much |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GoodDollar contribution | GoodDollar protocol (not GoodCash) | 10% of the G$ (exit contribution) |
| GoodCash fee | GoodCash | 1% of the payout |
| *Your app* fee | You (optional) | 0 to 3% of the payout, set in your agreement |
| Bank payout fee | Payout partner | about $0.02 per payout |
| Network fee | Celo network | paid in CELO from the wallet (not G$) |

How it is collected: the GoodCash fee and your fee are added together and collected in the same transaction by the
payout partner's sender fee, into the GoodCash Safe. GoodCash records your share of every paid cash out and pays
you monthly. You may also charge your users separately in your own app.

The fee the customer saw must equal the fee charged: the API refuses a cash out (`fee_mismatch`) otherwise.
Total fees (GoodCash + yours) are capped at 5%.

<!-- test-mode.md -->

# Test mode

Test keys (`gc_pk_test_...`, `gc_sk_test_...`) never touch real money, the payout partner, or the chain.

- **Banks:** `Test Bank A` (`TESTBANKA`) and `Test Bank B` (`TESTBANKB`). Any 10-digit number verifies as `TEST ACCOUNT`.
- **Prices:** fixed, so your tests are repeatable. Naira rate 1,500 per dollar.
- **Transactions:** `POST /v1/cashouts` returns a real-looking transaction with a 1970 deadline and a burn address,
  so it can never succeed even if sent. Don't send it: call `POST /v1/test/cashouts/{id}/simulate` (the SDK does this
  for you, and never asks the wallet to sign with a test key).
- **Timeline after simulate:** `sent` → `processing` after 5 s → outcome after 30 s, with webhooks.
- **No wallet needed:** the SDK uses a stand-in address when no wallet is connected.

| Account number | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| any other 10 digits | `paid` |
| `0000000001` | `failed` |
| `0000000002` | `refunded` |
| `0000000003` | stays `processing`, sends `cashout.delayed` |
| `0000000009` | name check fails (`bank_account_not_found`) |

## Top-ups (naira in)

Simulated end to end, no wallet, ID details or bank needed. `POST /v1/topups` creates one; it reads `awaiting_payment`, then
`paid_in` after about 5 seconds, then `delivered` after about 15 seconds, with webhooks. An amount ending in **13** fails
(`failed` after about 5 seconds). See [Add G$ / CELO with naira](quickstarts/topups.md).

Test data is deleted after 7 days.

<!-- webhooks.md -->

# Webhooks

Set your endpoint once per mode with your **secret key**:

```bash
curl -X PUT https://api.goodcash.xyz/v1/webhooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOODCASH_SECRET_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url":"https://your-server.example/goodcash"}'
```

The response contains `secret` (`whsec_...`) **once**. Store it. Lost it? Send `"rotateSecret": true`.
`POST /v1/webhooks/test` sends a signed `cashout.test` event.

## Events

`cashout.paid`, `cashout.failed`, `cashout.refunded`, `cashout.expired` (never signed), `cashout.delayed`
(not paid 25 minutes after sending), `cashout.test`. `data` is the cash out (same as `GET /v1/cashouts/{id}`).

If top-ups (naira in) are switched on for you: `topup.paid_in` (the naira arrived), `topup.delivered` (the G$ or CELO is in
the wallet), `topup.failed` (expired or refunded). `data` is the top-up (same as `GET /v1/topups/{id}`). See
[Add G$ / CELO with naira](quickstarts/topups.md).

Each event is sent once per change, at once; failures are retried after about 10 min, 30 min, 2 h and 12 h.
Answer 2xx within 5 seconds. The same event may arrive twice: ignore an `id` you have already handled.

## Verify every webhook

Header: `GoodCash-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>` where `v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")`.
Use the **raw** body (before JSON parsing). Reject if `t` is more than 5 minutes from now.

### Node (with the SDK)
```js
import { verifyWebhook } from '@goodcash/sdk/server';
const event = await verifyWebhook(rawBody, req.headers['goodcash-signature'], process.env.GOODCASH_WEBHOOK_SECRET);
```

### Node (no dependencies)
```js
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
function verify(raw, header, secret) {
  const m = /^t=(\d+),v1=([0-9a-f]{64})$/.exec(header || '');
  if (!m || Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(m[1])) > 300) return false;
  const want = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${m[1]}.${raw}`).digest('hex');
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(want), Buffer.from(m[2]));
}
```

### Python
```python
import hmac, hashlib, re, time
def verify(raw: bytes, header: str, secret: str) -> bool:
    m = re.fullmatch(r"t=(\d+),v1=([0-9a-f]{64})", header or "")
    if not m or abs(time.time() - int(m.group(1))) > 300:
        return False
    want = hmac.new(secret.encode(), m.group(1).encode() + b"." + raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(want, m.group(2))
```

### Go
```go
func Verify(raw []byte, header, secret string) bool {
	var t int64; var sig string
	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(header, "t=%d,v1=%s", &t, &sig); err != nil { return false }
	if d := time.Now().Unix() - t; d > 300 || d < -300 { return false }
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%d.", t))); mac.Write(raw)
	return hmac.Equal([]byte(hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))), []byte(sig))
}
```

<!-- errors.md -->

# Error codes

Every error has a stable `code`, a plain `message` you can show customers, and sometimes a `detail` for you.
API errors look like `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "detail": "..." } }`; the SDK throws `GoodCashError`
with the same fields plus `status` and `requestId`.

| Code | HTTP | What it means | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | A field is missing or malformed (`detail` names it) | Fix the request |
| `amount_too_small` | 400 | Below the minimum after fees | Show `quote.minimumG` |
| `amount_too_large` | 400 | Above the per-cash-out maximum | Use `/v1/limits` |
| `insufficient_balance` | 400 | The wallet holds less G$ than asked | Lower the amount |
| `fee_mismatch` | 409 | Fee changed since the quote you showed | Get and show a new quote |
| `price_unavailable` | 503 | Prices could not be read | Retry shortly |
| `cashout_paused` | 503 | GoodCash paused cash outs | Nothing was sent; retry later |
| `bank_account_not_found` | 400 | Name check failed | Ask the user to check bank and number |
| `needs_network_fee` (SDK) | - | Wallet lacks CELO for the network fee; `data` has `needCelo`, `haveCelo` | Ask the user to top up CELO |
| `wallet_rejected` (SDK) | - | The user cancelled in their wallet | Nothing was sent |
| `wrong_network` (SDK) | - | Wallet would not switch to Celo | Ask the user to switch |
| `no_wallet` (SDK) | - | No signer for a live cash out | Connect a wallet |
| `unsafe_transaction` (SDK) | - | The transaction failed the check before signing | Nothing was sent; retry; contact GoodCash if repeated |
| `order_expired` (SDK) | - | The payout window was about to close | Retry |
| `price_moved` (SDK) | - | The network refused before signing | Nothing was sent; retry |
| `uncertain` (SDK) | - | Wallet lost its reply and no payment was found yet; `data.cashOutId` | **Do not retry.** Tell the user to check history; poll `getCashOut` |
| `pending_confirmation` (SDK) | - | Sent, not confirmed yet | **Do not retry.** Keep watching |
| `transaction_mismatch` | 400 | Reported transaction is not this cash out | Report the right hash |
| `idempotency_conflict` | 409 | Same Idempotency-Key, different body | Use a new key per attempt |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests | Back off |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | Missing/unknown key | Check the key |
| `partner_disabled` | 403 | Your account is switched off | Contact GoodCash |
| `forbidden_origin` | 403 | Publishable key used from a site/app not on your list | Ask GoodCash to add it |
| `secret_key_in_browser` | 403 | Secret key sent from a browser | Use the publishable key there |
| `secret_key_required` | 403 | Endpoint needs the secret key | Call it from your server |
| `test_mode_only` | 400 | Simulation with a live key | Use a test key |
| `not_found` | 404 | No such cash out (for this key and mode) | Check the id and mode |
| `webhook_not_configured` | 400 | Test send without a URL | `PUT /v1/webhooks` first |
| `topups_not_enabled` | 403 | Live top-ups are not switched on for your account | Ask GoodCash to enable them (test mode needs no switch) |
| `invalid_signature` (server helper) | - | Webhook failed verification | Reject it (400) |
| `unavailable` / `network_error` | 503 / - | Temporary problem | Retry with back-off |

<!-- go-live.md -->

# Go-live checklist

Got your keys from the [self-serve page](https://pay.goodcash.xyz/docs/get-test-keys/)? Finish the list below, then ask for live access with your **test secret key** from your server: `POST https://api.goodcash.xyz/v1/live-access`. A person at GoodCash reviews it and replies by email.

- [ ] Agreement with GoodCash signed (fees, acceptable use, user checks for server-wallet payouts).
- [ ] Every site that loads the widget or uses the publishable key is on your allowed list (exact origins).
      Native apps: your app id is registered and sent as `X-GoodCash-App` (SDK option `appId`).
- [ ] The secret key is only on your server (environment variable / secret manager), never in an app or repo.
- [ ] Fees: you show every line from the quote, and pass the same quote to `cashOut()` (`feePercentShown`).
- [ ] You show the verified account name before the user confirms.
- [ ] `uncertain` and `pending_confirmation` are handled as "check history, don't retry".
- [ ] Webhook endpoint set for **live**, verifies signatures on the raw body, ignores repeated event ids, answers in < 5 s.
- [ ] You credit or notify users from webhooks (or `GET /v1/cashouts/{id}`), not from browser events alone.
- [ ] Server wallets (if any): key in a key manager, spending limits, alerting; it holds only what it needs.
- [ ] One small live cash out end to end with a real bank account, before announcing.
- [ ] Switch keys from `_test_` to `_live_`.
